outputs.role: Independent translucent conservation patches placed over the actual missing paper
outputs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. The reference is a recovered blank paper scroll with two real tears. Use it ONLY as the exact placement and camera guide. Output ONLY TWO thin Japanese conservation TISSUE PATCHES positioned to bridge those exact tears in the same square canvas. REMOVE the entire original receipt paper from the output. Actual transparent alpha surrounds and passes through these very thin patches. Main patch bridges the upper-left missing bite around the first quarter of the paper height, with generous8–12% overlap onto the surrounding surviving paper. A second smaller patch bridges the little lower-left edge split. Keep the same view, square framing and positions as the reference. These are semitransparent warm-ivory cellulose repair tissue, with a softly irregular hand-torn edge, a few visible organic pale fibres and a faint amber adhesive edge. The central membrane must genuinely be partly transparent, around25–45% opacity, with a few fibres more opaque, so the damaged original outline remains visible through it. The patch should provide physical support for missing paper, while still visibly showing the repair. No new original text or marks can appear on a replacement area. Do not reconstruct the original intact receipt, do not recolour the whole sheet and do not hide its torn contour. No stitches, woven cloth grid, gauze, medical bandage, decoration, handwriting, stamps, barcode, gold foil, letters, numbers or extra object. Fine crisp high-density PIXEL ART matching the reference's cream/peach/mauve material shading; avoid photorealistic transparent plastic glare and avoid heavy opaque beige rectangles. One isolated transparent patch-layer image at identical square composition, no background or paper backing.

LEFT CELL contains one small EMPTY conservation/lifting TRAY. It is a broad shallow oval-rectangle warm-grey/brass metal tray about5:1 width:height, with ivory enamel shallow floor, a subtle dark-violet underside, a thin rear rim and a separately readable narrow front lip. It will lift a fragile excavated receipt, so no contents, labels, ornament or glass cage. RIGHT CELL contains one small SOFT PAPER-CLEANING BRUSH, a diagonal short honey-wood handle, dull brass ferrule and a clearly visible fan of warm-ivory fine soft bristles gently fanning at the tip. The brush tip is a meaningful contact surface and the opposite handle can be held by a little robot. Both are genuine small3D-volume game props in the same elevated front three-quarter camera, crisp refined dense PIXEL ART with deliberate clusters, warm highlights and violet shadows, no smooth vector or blurred render. They must read at roughly210x40 texture pixels for the tray and90x55 texture pixels for the brush, with fine details as close-up bonus. Keep each isolated object centred in its own equal square cell with generous clear margins. Actual transparent alpha outside both props. No paper receipt, creature, hands, room, desk, dirt, floor shadow, text, tool label, border, glyph or background. Do not add unrelated tools.
